answer.summary: The frontend quality job failed at the i18n check: 3 locale values (de/es 'Radial', fr 'Relations') are identical to English, so the checker exits 1. This is deterministic and tied to the lang file edits in this PR, so a re-run will fail the same way. Fix by translating the values or adding them to scripts/i18n-loanwords.json. The excerpt does not show the failing unit tests, so that part is unverified.
